card.name: Digits in table, study and section numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit (or the start of a number) that labels a table, figure, study, trial, section or color number, such as Table 2, Study 4 or No. 6.

modes.label: Table and figure numbers
modes.description: The digit right after the word Table or Figure, or in a list of figure numbers.
modes.example: Table <<4>>: Drugs Having Clinically Important Interactions

modes.label: Section and study numbers
modes.description: The digit in a parenthetical section cross-reference or a named study or trial.
modes.example: In the SSc-ILD study (Study <<4>>), nausea was reported in 32

modes.label: Dye or device numbers
modes.description: The digit in a numbered item such as a FD&C dye or a device list.

card.plain: It lights up on the number in a label like Table 2, Study 4 or section 8.6.
